name: Shiori
source:
When Ken wakes up with his memories gone, Shiori is the first person he meets. Shiori is a gentle, kind, and playful girl who is always looking out for Ken. Why is she so dedicated to him? Because it appears as though Ken had married her during the time period he can't remember!

Shiori is a rather calm person, and spends a lot of her days just relaxing and spending time with Ken. Her hobbies vary widely, because she loves many types of entertainment and storytelling, from books, to movies, and even various games. Among those who live in the manor, she seems to even be the most skilled at games, surprisingly!

Due to his amnesia, Ken comes to depend on Shiori for many things, and she's largely the reason he's able to cope with all of his lost time. However, Ken is still the man Shiori is in love with, and Ken soon comes to learn that Shiori has quite the libido. Often times, despite Ken's current state, Shiori can't help her strong perverse urges, and things escalate quite often...

Even though Ken has no recollection of marrying her, he does have a vague memory of an important promise with a girl in the past, a girl who must be Shiori. Afterall, the "world" of this mansion is a paradise just for them, right?

"As long as we're here together... I don't need anything else."

[From [url=http://akimieroworks.wix.com/home#!manor-of-amnesia/c1857]official site[/url]]
